verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers CLAUDE.md, a project-root file read at every session that can be checked into a repo and shared across a team as common context, plus integrations to pull in Google Drive docs, Jira tickets, and Slack data. However, there is no dedicated 'shared workspace' or knowledge-hub feature for aggregating docs and repos as a persistent team source of truth—CLAUDE.md is a lightweight config file, not a workspace construct.
